Package modelling

Class BooleanVariable

java.lang.Object
modelling.Variable
modelling.BooleanVariable
public class BooleanVariable extends Variable
Represents a boolean variable in the Blocks World model. This class is a specialized version of the Variable class where the domain of possible values is restricted to true and false. It is typically used to represent boolean attributes of blocks, such as whether a block is "fixed" or "free".

    • isStackFreeVariable

      public static boolean isStackFreeVariable(Variable variable)
      Determines if the given variable represents a "Stack Free" boolean variable. A variable is considered a "Stack Free" variable if its name is a negative integer and it is an instance of the BooleanVariable class.
      Parameters:
      variable - The variable to check.
      Returns:
      true if the variable's name is negative and it is an instance of BooleanVariable, false otherwise.

    • isBlockFixedVariable

      public static boolean isBlockFixedVariable(Variable variable)
      Determines if the given variable represents a "Block Fixed" boolean variable. A variable is considered a "Block Fixed" variable if its name is a non-negative integer and it is an instance of the BooleanVariable class.
      Parameters:
      variable - The variable to check.
      Returns:
      true if the variable's name is non-negative and it is an instance of BooleanVariable, false otherwise.
